title: iWAM: Efficient Action Prediction from World Models without Explicit Future Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.33141v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) build policies on pretrained video-generation models, on the premise that predicting how a scene evolves helps determine how to act. However, generating future scenes is expensive for real-time control. This motivates efficient proxies for future imagination, but how to train such proxies without sacrificing action-prediction quality remains unclear. An effective proxy need not generate a high-resolution frame; it only needs to provide enough information to distinguish between possible futures. This leads to the design principle behind iWAM: rather than denoising an entire future frame, can we condition the action policy on intermediate features from a single video-model evaluation? We show that the answer is yes. Exploiting the reversible dynamics of flow-matching models, we invert each training future into the corresponding latent noise vector. translated_title: iWAM：无需显式未来预测的世界模型高效动作预测
translated_abstract: 世界-动作模型（World-action models, WAMs）在预训练的视频生成模型之上构建策略，其前提是：预测场景如何演化有助于决定如何行动。然而，生成未来场景对于实时控制而言代价高昂。这促使人们寻求“未来想象”的高效代理，但如何在训练此类代理的同时不牺牲动作预测质量仍不明确。一个有效的代理并不需要生成高分辨率帧；它只需提供足够的信息来区分可能的未来。由此引出了 iWAM 背后的设计原则：与其对整个未来帧进行去噪，我们能否让动作策略以单次视频模型评估所产生的中间特征为条件？我们证明答案是肯定的。利用流匹配模型的可逆动力学，我们将每个训练样本的未来反演为对应的潜在噪声向量。然而，在该潜变量处进行单次速度评估并不能……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 iWAM，利用流匹配模型的可逆动力学将未来反演为潜噪声向量，仅以单次视频模型评估的中间特征来条件化动作策略，从而无需显式生成未来帧即可实现高效的动作预测。
en_tdlr: iWAM exploits the reversible dynamics of flow-matching models to invert training futures into latent noise vectors and conditions the action policy on intermediate features from a single video-model evaluation, enabling efficient action prediction without explicitly generating future frames.
